title: An assigned case starts work and records the resolution attempt
risk: Work begins without any recorded attempt, so a later escalation has no history and the customer repeats the same problem.
preconditions: An ASSIGNED order-status case CASE-T1-0003 for cust-a linked to ORD-A-1 in namespace cd-progress-*
Order lookup available through the stubbed ERP fixture

steps.action: Start work on the assigned case
steps.expected: state becomes IN_PROGRESS with a start timestamp and the owner unchanged

steps.action: Record the lookup attempt against ORD-A-1 with its source reference
steps.expected: the case links an evidence record that references ORD-A-1 and the skill id used

steps.action: Attempt to start work on a case that is still CLASSIFIED
steps.expected: the transition is refused as an invalid state transition and the case state is unchanged
the IN_PROGRESS transition and the evidence link appear once each in chronological order

assertions: The case reports IN_PROGRESS with exactly one evidence link to ORD-A-1
Starting work from CLASSIFIED is refused with an invalid-transition error
The case timeline shows the transition and the evidence link exactly once each
forbidden: Report IN_PROGRESS without any recorded resolution attempt
Overwrite the assigned owner while starting work
evidence: Case projection and evidence link (source reference, skill id)
Invalid-transition audit entry from the CLASSIFIED attempt
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped case and evidence link for cd-progress-*; keep the audit entries
automation: Call the real manage_case skill with the ERP adapter stubbed by fixtures/offline/orders.json; assert on the evidence linkage rather than on the state string alone.
